Gaze of the Black Knight
27% of base mana
Instant3 min cooldown
Apply a dark shield to yourself, absorbing 3255+0+Sta*7+AP*.41 damage and then gaze upon your party members, causing 25% of the damage they take to be transferred to you for 12 sec.

Damage which reduces your health below 20% will break the effect.

Usable while stunned.
